assertion_audit.assertions: replacement differs; elapsed <= two periods; retained earlier rows padded with dash; exactly one active sampler after every start and replacement alone at end
assertion_audit.fails_if: Restoring the base start-only launcher prevents an added-column row and times out; restoring archive-on-schema-change loses earlier rows; overlapping starts make the active set exceed one. Missing cross-path transition is the blocking finding.

assertion_audit.assertions: two rows; old data mapped into retained columns; current row present; no archive file
assertion_audit.fails_if: Restoring rename-to-archive produces one row in the canonical series and an archive; dropping or misplacing old values fails the independent kept/dash expectations. Current-row equality is a round-trip assertion using the supplied schema, not independent protection for the canonical column list; durability rests on preservation and row count, not that equality.

assertion_audit.assertions: admission open; missing kind; fleet-health owner/reason; no held claim or launch remedy
assertion_audit.fails_if: Restoring generic unreadable classification, omitting owner or restoring the before-admission instruction fails the respective literal checks; fixture admission reserve is independently set to zero.

assertion_audit.assertions: refuses unidentified lock holder; sends no signals; emits refusal
assertion_audit.fails_if: Treating an unidentified lock as free, signalling an unverified target or suppressing refusal breaks the respective assertion; actual flock is held by the test.

assertion_audit.assertions: returned child PID and checkout script selected despite stale PATH resolution
assertion_audit.fails_if: Restoring unconditional shutil.which selects the deliberately different stale path and fails argv equality; PID equality alone is fixture plumbing, not protection for script selection.

assertion_audit.assertions: raises FleetNodeError; original contents remain; only original and lock file exist
assertion_audit.fails_if: Accepting unknown headers or malformed rows, publishing a partial conversion or leaving a temporary file breaks these independently specified content/path assertions.

assertion_audit.assertions: successful pass; rejecting system python never invoked; four helper fields known zero; series disk figures equal published figures
assertion_audit.fails_if: Restoring any python3 fallback writes the rejecting interpreter marker and yields unknown helper values; restoring disk fallback prevents the JSON publication. Disk equality only checks agreement between publication and row, not independent filesystem accuracy; the no-marker and successful helper checks provide fallback protection.

assertion_audit.assertions: absent publication expected kind is node-disk-missing in admission, direct/published obligations and queued launch
assertion_audit.fails_if: Restoring FileNotFoundError to the generic unreadable branch makes each literal missing-kind assertion fail; stale and malformed classifications remain separately expected.

findings.text: blocking: The old sampler is filtered against the replacement's pathname before its held lock descriptor is examined; the base launcher selected fleet-health through PATH whereas the new default selects _checkout_root()/bin/fleet-health, so an existing legitimate sampler at another installed or checkout path yields zero candidates, _stop_health_sampler returns False and start_health_sampler returns without replacing it. Identify the previous sampler independently of the destination path while retaining ownership checks, and cover a handover from one script path to another; the current rehearsal only rewrites the same path.
